sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a four-digit number and prints "Armstrong Number" when the sum of its four digits each raised to the fourth power equals the number, otherwise "Not an Armstrong Number".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It sums N[0] through N[3] raised to the power len(N), so a four-digit input is required for the intended result.
